copy.tagline: 遵循编码标准与最佳实践，提升代码质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 TypeScript、React 或 Node.js 项目中需要统一的编码规范
copy.tagline_en: Follow coding standards and best practices to improve code quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need unified coding standards in TypeScript, React, or Node.js projects

howto.what: Claude 会按照 TypeScript、JavaScript、React、Node.js 的通用编码标准和最佳实践来生成代码，包括命名规范、错误处理、类型安全、组件结构等。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 编写或审查 TypeScript、JavaScript、React、Node.js 代码时，它会自动应用这些标准。

say.text: 帮我写一个 React 按钮组件，包含类型定义。
审查这段代码，指出不符合编码标准的地方。
say.note: Claude 会检查命名、错误处理、不可变性等。

say.text: 用 async/await 重写这段 Promise 链。
say.note: Claude 会应用异步最佳实践，如并行执行。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate code following general coding standards and best practices for TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and Node.js, including naming conventions, error handling, type safety, and component structure.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to write or review TypeScript, JavaScript, React, or Node.js code, it will automatically apply these standards.

say_en.text: Write a React button component with type definitions.
Review this code and point out violations of coding standards.
say_en.note: Claude will check naming, error handling, immutability, etc.

say_en.text: Rewrite this Promise chain using async/await.
say_en.note: Claude will apply async best practices like parallel execution.
